data.title: Implementation of an Integrated Hospital Management Information System (HMIS) across Four Tertiary-Care Hospitals
data.issuer: Provincial Health Department, Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Peshawar
data.summary: The Provincial Health Department, Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa invites sealed proposals to supply, implement, integrate, and support an integrated Hospital Management Information System across four tertiary-care hospitals. The scope includes EMR; OPD/IPD, LIS/RIS, pharmacy/inventory, billing/insurance, a central data warehouse with dashboards, HL7/FHIR integration, legacy data migration, training for ~1,200 staff, and three years of post-implementation support and maintenance.

qa_items.question: Q1. Company profile, registrations, and certifications.
Q2. Relevant project experience with verifiable references.
Q3. Proposed solution architecture and interoperability approach.
Q4. Implementation plan, migration methodology, and training plan.
Q5. Support and maintenance model with SLAs.

data.submission_instructions: Submit sealed proposals in two separate sealed envelopes marked "Technical Proposal" and "Financial Proposal".
